headword: {社外活動|しゃがいかつどう}

definitions.explanation: Activities conducted outside of one's primary company or workplace, such as volunteer work, professional associations, side projects, networking events, or community involvement.

examples.japanese: {社外活動|しゃがいかつどう}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Outside-company activities are also subject to evaluation.

examples.japanese: {社外活動|しゃがいかつどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|つう}じて→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧、⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{知|し}り{合|あ}えた→知り合う：03072_shiriau⟧。
examples.english: Through outside-company activities, I was able to meet people from different industries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{社外活動|しゃがいかつどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奨励|しょうれい}→奨励：12213_shourei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧きて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, more companies are encouraging their employees to engage in activities outside of work.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{社外|しゃがい}→社外：17992_shagai⟧ (outside the company) and ⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧ (activities). Reflects the evolving Japanese work culture where employees are increasingly encouraged to develop skills and connections beyond their employer.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社外活動|しゃがいかつどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧: to participate in outside-company activities
- {社外活動|しゃがいかつどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奨励|しょうれい}→奨励：12213_shourei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to encourage outside activities
- {社外活動|しゃがいかつどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧: report on external activities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{課外活動|かがいかつどう}→課外活動：08605_kagaikatsudou⟧: extracurricular activities — used in school contexts
- {社内活動|しゃないかつどう}: in-company activities — the opposite
- ⟦{副業|ふくぎょう}→副業：08479_fukugyou⟧: side job — a specific type of outside activity
